title: Carmen's move to television and family visits
summary: She leaves the Globe for a Boston TV station and Fields visits her and Chief.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: How long has she been there?
She's not even there now, but she worked on, and while we're speaking I kind of wish she was there, but as I said, her love was TV.
Finally she just went on there

and she could have got a TV job, a good while ago, but some of them was with a major station, and so finally she landed an opening in Boston, in a TV station, and she came and said she did everything right there, thirty day notice, you know, and she's in TV now.
But frankly speaking, I can tell from experience, the way she talks, she's not at ease as she was with the newspaper. But she wanted TV.
Do you get to see her pretty often?
Yes. I haven't seen her, but most likely she'll come and visit us this year, around Christmas. Last summer I spent a little over a week with her.
Not this summer that just passed, the summer before last, and that was at the same
time I was going to spend two weeks and I spent about a week and a half with her and the other three days with Chief.
Now, when do you get to see Ernie Jr.?
